title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Payment Arrangements for TRAC Deficiencies
content:
# Arrangement Terms — Paying a TRAC Deficiency under a Kestrel Payment Arrangement, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

## Terms

1. A business may pay a TRAC deficiency on a Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease unit under a Kestrel payment arrangement set up at its own request, and only such a deficiency: the first arrangement payment is made when the arrangement is set up and is figured as this policy states, and the rest of the arranged balance falls due in equal monthly arrangement payments; a deficiency paid without an arrangement is due the tier's TRAC deficiency payment period, in calendar days, after the settlement invoice, as before.

2. An arrangement payment is booked on the unit against its charges due without being recorded against any rental invoice month, and is never applied to a rental invoice month; any other business payment is applied to the oldest unpaid invoice month first unless the remittance names the months it pays, as before.

3. The first arrangement payment is fixed only after the unit's ledger carries the deficiency charge billed for its sale settlement.

Term 3 is a condition of the unit's own ledger: while the ledger does not yet carry the deficiency charge billed for the sale settlement, the first arrangement payment is not yet fixed.

| Payment | How it is applied |
|---|---|
| Arrangement payment | against the unit's charges due, recorded against no rental invoice month |
| Any other business payment | to the oldest unpaid invoice month first, unless the remittance names the months it pays |

## System reference — `remit_arrangement_payment_506aa8ae`

**Capability.** The business's named authorized signer authorizes a payment under a deficiency payment arrangement on one of its fleet unit lease schedules. One business payment is booked on the named unit, dated today, in the amount given, with the channel chosen recorded on it, recorded against no rental invoice month, and the unit's charges due balance falls by that amount. The business sees the payment, its amount and its channel among the unit's postings.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The servicing agent unlocks `remit_arrangement_payment_506aa8ae` and hands it over; the customer themselves — the business's named authorized signer — runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `fleet_unit_id` | the reference number of the fleet unit lease schedule the payment is applied to, as the servicing agent reads it out from the fleet unit lookup | identifier |
| `amount` | the payment amount in USD | a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent; no currency symbol |
| `payment_channel` | the payment channel recorded on the payment | one of: `ach_debit` — a one-time debit of the business's bank account on file authorized by the signer; `ach_credit` — an ACH credit from the business's own bank; `wire` — a bank wire from the business; `business_check` — a check from the business; `not_applicable` — for a posting that moves no money, never used for a payment |

**Return.** On success, a confirmation line naming the payment reference number (an opaque identifier for the payment, also recorded as its remittance reference), the fleet unit reference number, the amount in USD with 2 decimal places, the channel as chosen, the posting date in YYYY-MM-DD form, and the unit's charges due balance in USD with 2 decimal places with the payment applied. A line beginning "Error:" means no unit matched the reference number and nothing was posted.
